says: reach is Effect.fn("brain.reach"), so every call through it opens a span that keeps the call's failure, and an unreachable LedgerError's message holds what the platform threw, which can be a letter's text.
proof: With ProcessClient calling reach directly, next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/mail.test.ts 'T1b [secrets]: Process mailed rejections hold no mail' failed: 'input text leaked: brain.reach ... LedgerError: Error: BODY...'. It passes once the call runs under Effect.withTracerEnabled(false).
cost: Each slice that routes a client through reach (S1, S3, S4) adds a span per call and can leak a letter's text into spans, unless it repeats the same wrapper; Effect.fnUntraced in reach.ts would fix it once.
